name: Niemus
backstory: One of the Salthos house's guards, posted at the crossing before the tollhouse fell; wasn't there himself the night Auroboro's raid took it, and has only ever had the story as everyone else does.

experience.text: Had a child with Darius, named Nierius.
Had a child with Darius, named Darnus.
Heard that Fenserika and Darius now have a child, Darika.
Heard that Magus and Nierius now have a child, Niergus.
Had a child with Darius, named Niemius.
Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnakus.
Heard that Fenserika and Nierius now have a child, Fenrius.
Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnukas.
Heard that Prince Doran and Niemius now have a child, Niemoran.
Had a child with Nakus, named Niekus.
Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dornakus.

criterion.standard: counts holding his post steady regardless of whose version of that night is true
criterion.wasted_life: guarding a crossing whose own history he only ever knew secondhand
criterion.origin: collision between his backstory (posted at the crossing, but not present for the raid itself) and the sample's crossing_toll_dispute
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn and dusk, checks travelers' papers at the crossing, listens more than he talks

needs: a surviving witness who was physically at the tollhouse the night it fell
arc.premise: Niemus wants to find someone who was actually posted at the tollhouse itself the night Auroboro's raid took it - not another telling, someone who was there - and hear it once, plainly, from them.
